paragraphs.text: Gyrus , Waker of Corpses is a hydra from Alara .

The terrifying hydra Gyrus hunts in the swamps of Jund , one of the reunited shards of Alara , but not alone. Its heads dredge dead things from the murky water and animate them as shadows of their former selves. Zombified crocodiles , snakes , and other creatures serve Gyrus, bringing food to blunt the hydra's insatiable hunger.
